# Calculator Soup

> > Comprehensive online calculator resource providing free tools for mathematics, finance, construction, conversions, and statistics.

Calculator Soup, created by Edward Furey, offers hundreds of specialized calculators organized by category to help users solve practical problems in personal finance, construction estimation, unit conversions, and recreational mathematics. Each calculator includes detailed explanations and formulas.

## Getting Started

- [Calculators | Calculator Soup](https://calculatorsoup.com): Homepage featuring calculator directory for math, finance, and conversions
- [Help Notes for CalculatorSoup.com](https://calculatorsoup.com/help/index.php): Help documentation for sharing results, notation, and widget embedding

## Financial Calculators

- [Personal Finance and Accounting Calculators](https://calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/index-personal-finance-and-accounting.php): Personal banking, checkbook balance, salary conversion calculators
- [Hourly to Salary Calculator – Convert Hourly Pay to Annual Income](https://calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/hourly-to-salary-calculator.php): Convert hourly wage to annual salary with overtime calculations

## Construction & Material Calculators

- [Construction Calculators](https://calculatorsoup.com/calculators/construction/index.php): Volume, concrete, feet-inches, and material estimation calculators
- [Gravel Calculator](https://calculatorsoup.com/calculators/construction/gravel-calculator.php): Estimate gravel volume for driveways, patios, and construction projects
- [Topsoil Calculator](https://calculatorsoup.com/calculators/construction/topsoil-calculator.php): Calculate topsoil volume for gardening and landscaping projects
- [Road Base Calculator | Roadway Fill Volume](https://calculatorsoup.com/calculators/construction/roadway.php): Calculate road base fill volume for asphalt and driveway construction

## Games & Recreation

- [Games & Sports Calculators](https://calculatorsoup.com/calculators/games/index.php): Lottery generators, dice rollers, NFL picks, and sports probability tools
